client._kind_source: The world registers its own Archipelago client and carries the code that talks to the emulator, so London installs the apworld and starts the emulator only. Its own registration, read from the package's __init__.py: `Component("SneakKingClient", func=launch_client, component_type=Type.CLIENT, file_identifier=SuffixIdentifier(".apsk"), description="Open the Sneak King client.")`
